description: Write a tiled Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF in EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) with overviews and DEFLATE compression beside the original file.
inputInstructions:
Converts a georeferenced TIFF into a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) that the Search map can draw. The original file is never changed.

Output: <file name>.cog.tif in the same folder of the same asset (a.tif becomes a.tif.cog.tif). Running the workflow again on a new version of the original writes a new version of the COG.

The COG is written in EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator), the only coordinate system the map viewer draws, so the pixels are resampled from the original's coordinate system. A COG that is already in EPSG:3857, and a TIFF with no georeference, are left alone and the run notes why in its results.

Settings in the template body:
  compression  DEFLATE (the only value today).

This pipeline reads no asset metadata.
